source: GoogleTrendArchive: Google Trends 'Trending Now' national feeds for 125 countries, collected every 10 minutes, Nov. 27, 2024 to May 17, 2026. Topics merged by the world-attention pipeline.
note: Two returns on one clock: cumulative new countries from the third new country's first trend (minutes; every 10 min to 6 h, then hourly), up to 24 hours. Countries already searching the story in the 24 hours before are left out (already_trending). Baseline: every non-sport moment reaching 50+ countries within 72 hours.
takeaway: When Damascus fell, searches spread over half a day; when the United States struck Iran, 50 countries were searching within the hour.
